paragraphs.text: Erayo (eh-RYE-oh) , Soratami Ascendent , was a moonfolk monk of kamigawa .

Around the time of the Kami War , Erayo was an enlightened soratami monk whose meditations enabled her to transcend the material world. After ascending, Erayo became a powerful, legendary enchantment known as Erayo's Essence that represented the focused essence of her mortal form similar to Incarnations .
